intro_text.en: Start with a practical situation,draw the model,and solve one step at a time.
intro_text.gu: Practical પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂ કરીએ,model દોરીએ અને એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલીએ.

h.en: 6.1.1 The shaft carries a turning effect

body.en:
Start with a situation

A motor turns a shaft connected to a load. The shaft transmits torque and twists even if its diameter appears unchanged.

Definition

Torque is the turning moment about an axis; angle of twist is relative angular rotation between shaft sections. Torsion creates shear stress in a circular shaft.

Understand the reason

Strength limits shear stress; stiffness limits twist. A shaft can pass one check and fail the other.

Example / application

A long slender shaft may twist too much even when maximum shear stress is acceptable.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Torque units N·m and power units W are not interchangeable; power also depends on angular speed.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Motor shaftથી load ફેરવે.Shaft torque વહન કરે,twist થાય,ભલે diameter બદલાતો ન દેખાય.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Torque axis વિશે turning moment છે;angle of twist shaft sections વચ્ચેનું relative angular rotation છે.Circular shaftમાં torsion shear stress બનાવે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Strength shear stress limit કરે;stiffness twist limit કરે.Shaft એક checkમાં pass,બીજામાં fail થઈ શકે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Maximum shear acceptable હોવા છતાં લાંબો પાતળો shaft વધારે twist થઈ શકે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Torque N·m અને power W એક નથી;power angular speed પર પણ આધારિત છે.

body.en:
Understand the reason

The elementary circular-shaft theory assumes straight prismatic circular geometry, homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic material, small deformation and loading as torque about the shaft axis.

Plane cross-sections remain plane and rotate as rigid discs; radial lines remain straight. The model applies away from local end/stress-concentration effects.

Remember / avoid this mistake

For noncircular shafts warping changes the solution; do not use circular-shaft formulas merely by inserting an equivalent diameter.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Elementary circular-shaft theoryમાં straight prismatic circular geometry,homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic material,small deformation અને shaft axis વિશે torque loading માનીએ.

Plane cross-sections plane રહી rigid discsની જેમ ફરે;radial lines straight રહે.Model local end/stress-concentration effectsથી દૂર લાગુ પડે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Noncircular shaftsમાં warpingથી solution બદલાય;equivalent diameter મૂકી circular formula ન લો.

body.en:
Definition

T/J=tau/r=Gtheta/L for a uniform circular shaft under constant torque. HereJ is polar area moment, theta is in radians, G is shear modulus.

Shear stress varies linearly with radius:tau(r)=Tr/J.Maximum occurs at outer radius R; for a solid shaft stress is zero at its centre.

Solid:J=pi d⁴/32, tau max=16T/(pi d³).Hollow:J=pi(D⁴−d⁴)/32, tau max=16TD/[pi(D⁴−d⁴)].

Remember / avoid this mistake

At the inner surface of a hollow shaft the stress is generally nonzero; there is no material at the centre.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Constant torqueવાળા uniform circular shaft માટે T/J=tau/r=Gtheta/L.અહીં J polar area moment,theta radiansમાં,G shear modulus છે.

Shear stress radius સાથે linear બદલાય:tau(r)=Tr/J.Maximum outer radius R પર;solid shaftના centre પર stress zero.

Solid:J=pi d⁴/32,tau max=16T/(pi d³).Hollow:J=pi(D⁴−d⁴)/32,tau max=16TD/[pi(D⁴−d⁴)].

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Hollow shaftની inner surface પર stress સામાન્ય રીતે nonzero છે;centre પર material જ નથી.

body.en:
Given

Solid d40 mm, L1000 mm, T500 N·m, G80000 MPa; ideal circular-shaft theory.

Stepwise solution

  1. T=500000 N·mm; J=pi×40⁴/32=251327.41 mm⁴
  2. tau max=500000×20/251327.41=39.7887 MPa
  3. theta=TL/(GJ)=.0248680rad=1.42483°

Remember / avoid this mistake

ConvertN·m toN·mm before usingmm, MPa; convert radians to degrees only after solving.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Solid d40mm,L1000mm,T500N·m,G80000MPa;ideal circular-shaft theory.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. T=500000N·mm;J=pi×40⁴/32=251327.41mm⁴
  2. tau max=500000×20/251327.41=39.7887MPa
  3. theta=TL/(GJ)=.0248680rad=1.42483°

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

mm,MPa સાથે N·mને N·mmમાં ફેરવો;solve થયા પછી જ radiansને degrees કરો.

body.en:
Definition

GJ is torsional rigidity; GJ/L is torque per unit twist for a uniform segment. For stepped segments, theta total=sumTi Li/(Gi Ji) using signed internal torque Ti.

Strength design requires tau max≤tau allowable. Stiffness design requires |theta|≤theta allowable. Check fatigue, notches, combined loads and applicable design factors separately in real service.

Example / application

For a solid shaft:Tallow=(pi/16)tau allow d³, while twist varies as1/d⁴ for fixed T, L, G.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A hollow shaft comparison must state equal mass, equal outer diameter or another fair basis; otherwise “always stronger” is meaningless.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

GJ torsional rigidity છે;uniform segmentમાં GJ/L unit twist દીઠ torque છે.Stepped segmentsમાં signed internal torque Ti સાથે theta total=sum Ti Li/(Gi Ji).

Strengthમાં tau max≤tau allowable;stiffnessમાં |theta|≤theta allowable જોઈએ.Real serviceમાં fatigue,notches,combined loads,applicable design factors અલગ તપાસો.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Solid shaft માટે Tallow=(pi/16)tau allow d³;fixed T,L,Gમાં twist1/d⁴ પ્રમાણે બદલાય.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Hollow shaftની comparisonમાં equal mass,equal outer diameter કે fair basis આપો;નહિ તો “હંમેશાં stronger”નો અર્થ નથી.

body.en:
Given

HollowD60 mm, d40 mm, T1 kN·m; separately size a solid shaft for the same torque with allowable shear50 MPa.

Stepwise solution

  1. J=pi(60⁴−40⁴)/32=1021017.61 mm⁴
  2. tau outer=1000000×30/J=29.3825 MPa
  3. tau inner=1000000×20/J=19.5883 MPa
  4. Solid required d=[16×1000000/(pi×50)]^(1/3)=46.7018 mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

A practical selected diameter must not be below the requirement; also check twist and real design requirements before selection.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Hollow D60mm,d40mm,T1kN·m;અલગથી એ જ torque અને allowable shear50MPa માટે solid shaft size લો.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. J=pi(60⁴−40⁴)/32=1021017.61mm⁴
  2. tau outer=1000000×30/J=29.3825MPa
  3. tau inner=1000000×20/J=19.5883MPa
  4. Solid required d=[16×1000000/(pi×50)]^(1/3)=46.7018mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Practical selected diameter requirementથી નાનો નહિ;selection પહેલાં twist,real design requirements પણ જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition

PowerP=Tomega andomega=2pi N/60 for speed N inrpm. WithP inkW, T inN·m:T=60×1000P/(2pi N)≈9549.3P/N.

Mechanical horsepower is approximately745.7W; metric horsepower is approximately735.5W.State which convention is used instead of treating HP as a single SI unit.

Remember / avoid this mistake

At the same power, lower speed needs higher torque; at zero speed P=Tomega is zero even if a static torque is present.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Power P=Tomega અને speed N rpm માટે omega=2pi N/60.P kWમાં,T N·mમાં:T=60×1000P/(2pi N)≈9549.3P/N.

Mechanical horsepower લગભગ745.7W;metric horsepower લગભગ735.5W.કઈ convention છે તે કહો;HPને એક જ SI unit ન માનો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Same powerમાં speed ઓછી તો torque વધુ;zero speed પર static torque હોય છતાં P=Tomega zero છે.

body.en:
Given

P15 kW, N300 rpm; ignore transmission loss only for this calculation.

Stepwise solution

  1. omega=2pi×300/60=31.4159rad/s
  2. T=15000/31.4159=477.4648 N·m
  3. Mechanical HP=15000/745.7=20.1153HP

Remember / avoid this mistake

Use transmitted power at the shaft of interest; motor input and downstream shaft output are not necessarily equal.

Quick check: If speed halves at fixed power, what happens to torque?

It doubles, subject to the operating limits of the system.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

P15kW,N300rpm;આ ગણતરીમાં જ transmission loss અવગણો.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. omega=2pi×300/60=31.4159rad/s
  2. T=15000/31.4159=477.4648N·m
  3. Mechanical HP=15000/745.7=20.1153HP

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

જે shaftનો પ્રશ્ન છે તેનું transmitted power લો;motor input,downstream output જરૂરી નથી કે સરખાં હોય.

જાતે વિચારો: Fixed Powerમાં Speed અડધી તો Torque?

System operating limitsમાં torque બમણો થાય.

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. Draw applied torques/support reactions; find internal torque in each segment; compute J; apply strength/twist equations with consistent units.
  2. State assumptions and whether the question asks strength, stiffness, power or all three. Label the radial shear distribution and use radians inside the equation.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Applied torques/support reactions દોરો;દરેક segmentનો internal torque શોધો;J ગણો;consistent unitsથી strength/twist equations લો.
  2. Assumptions અને પ્રશ્ન strength,stiffness,power કે ત્રણેયનો છે તે લખો.Radial shear distribution label કરો,equationમાં radians લો.
